[quote=vespurias;61003945]Vespurias would schedule constructions, paid for entirely by the nation ourselves, in six different locations, for the next eight months, with similar nine month long discussions and valuing of Dushkaria, to add to the Vespurian database and update relationships and public information properly across Vespurias. A phoenix animal care manual is sent with the ambassadors, who for the moment will purchase a private property to live in until the embassies are constructed. In the meantime, it'll give time to the counterpart's foreign office to gather manpower, and to help them, a few senior retired diplomats would go and offer to aid for the next ten months.[/quote]

[i]To fully prepare for these visitors, military patrols would increase drastically around the capital and their properties to ensure that the Salvation Government cannot interfere with or attack them. This has caused Several Mammut 3s (STRV 2000) to re-enter service, along with a multitude of dormant and unused military equipment, to ensure that the Dushkari military can protect the embassies and any other foreign staff from potential insurgent attacks.

The previously discharged diplomatic corps are to be reinstated and return to their offices immediately. In addition, major projects have begun to make the capital more welcoming to visitors. The Supreme Commander has also been tasked by the Senate and Parliament to ensure that any and all diplomatic talks will benefit Dushkaria and her potential ally.[/i]

[Spoiler=2 offers]
[B]foreign ministry
Time: 9:43[/b] 

[I]on a slightly cold morning james, state secretary of foreign affairs enters his office and takes off his coat. He plops down his chair and sees a small stack of telegrams infront of him. He starts reading through every one and as he expected it's the less important messages that get dumped on his desk because the other diplomats are too lazy to read or have better things to do. When James gets to the last one he looks down and is surprised to see a telegram straight from Neudresden, "interesting..." he mutters. James opens the telegram and stafts reading what's written in it, his eyebrows go up as it's the last thing he expected.
James quickly stands up and runs to the foreign minister.[/i] 

"Thank you people for being today for the weekly meeting." Says prime minister Viswaard as he looks around the room, each minister currently sits down and looks at him, expecting him to continue.
"Today on the agen-"
The doorslams open and James pants a bit before seeing that the session has already started, "sorry for interrupting but it's kinda important." James puts the telegram infront the foreign minister and Viswaard asks, "what are the contents?"
"NeuDresden wants to buy our last colony from us."
Every minister in the room looked at James in surprise, a few whispered to eachother and Viswaard asks, "how much do they ask?"
James coughs a bit and says, "20 billion."
Viswaard looks down at the table for a bit before announcing, "today's agenda will be discussed later, current subject will be the offer from NeuDresden."[/i] 

[I]As the meeting progresses every minister doesn't find it hard to choose to accept the offer with the threat from Paldea on the horizon.
Eventually Viswaard says, "Time for the vote, in favor?"
Every hand rises up in the room.
"Opposed?"
No hands.
"Everyone in favor here? Good. Parliament can vote on the sale of the colony to NeuDresden next week." 

When the meeting is finally over everyone walks out of the room back to their own ministries.
As the afternoon starts James calls Viswaard again and says, "withdraw the colony sale to NeuDresden for the time mister Viswaard. Luscaria just send an offer to buy the colony from us."
This made Viswaard pay more attention and he said, "how much?"
"25 Billion, and a binding security agreement"
James then gets another telegram from a diplomat, he reads it and says, "NeuDresden raises its offer to 25 billion"
Viswaard looks down and says, "damn it Will be hard to decide on this.."[/spoiler]
